Delhi High Court SPA & PA Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : High Court of Delhi (DHC) has released the notification for the post of Senior Personal Assistant (SPA) & Personal Assistant (PA). This recruitment has been issued for 150 posts. The online application process for Delhi High Court SPA & PA Recruitment 2026 will start from 15 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 05 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Delhi High Court SPA & PA Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 05 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 15 September 2026
  • Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 October 2026
  • Correction Window : 12 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, BC, Female : Rs. 1300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Delhi High Court SPA & PA Online Form 2026?

Delhi High Court SPA & PA Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 05 October 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://www.delhihighcourt.nic.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
